summary.headline: Planetary Stations and Visibility
summary.text: Judgments of Mercury’s retrogradation in Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, followed by the effects of the stations of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury on rulers, social groups, commerce, weather, and public welfare. The tenth chapter defines the concealment and appearance of wandering planets in relation to the solar rays.
